unitemized.reason: Depends on 'only task evidence is available', which can't be observed or written as an applies_when predicate.
Depends on artifacts being unreadable or lacking usable requirements/scenarios/decisions, which can't be written as a predicate. The verify template also has no per-check labels.
Describes which checks each missing input affects. It is a mapping for other rules, not a check on its own.
Depends on the status JSON field taskTrackingConfigured, which no predicate in the reference language can see.
Depends on the status JSON field unavailableTrackingFiles, which can't be observed through the reference predicates.
Depends on taskTrackingConfigured and the status 'tasks' field plus apply state/instruction. None of these can be written as a predicate.
Depends on skip_specs status or the schema having no spec artifact. That can't be written as a predicate, and this schema does define a spec artifact.
